item: A test run fails when configs/ changes during it; the parse-memo test names what its two passes read
summary: One macOS -n 4 leg failed test_catalogue_parse_memo: its two seed passes disagreed by whole catalogues. A 50 ms watch of configs/ and the repo root through a full local shard-2 run at -n 4 saw no file change, and the memo is already reset per test (keyed on the text's sha256), so the cause is not found. Every process now fingerprints configs/ at session start and end and fails the run naming a changed file; the test, on a mismatch, prints each pass's catalogue inputs, memo state, live threads and rows by provenance.
